name: Taishou Yakyuu Musume. ~Otome-tachi no Seishun Nikki~
original_name: 大正野球娘。～乙女達乃青春日記～
source:
Koume is a girls' high school student. One day, Akiko, her close friend, suddenly says to Koume, "I would like you to play baseball with me!" Koume accepts her offer, but can they collect nine players? What do they need first? How about the rules? Will they be able to win against a boys' team...?

[From HimeyaShop]
translation:
铃川小梅是一名女学生。一天，好友小笠原晶子突然对她说：“我希望你和我一起打棒球！”小梅接受了邀请，可她们能凑齐九名队员吗？首先需要准备什么？规则又是什么？她们真的能战胜男子队伍吗……？

[摘自HimeyaShop]
